title: First Lessons: Thorns
introNarration: Mentor Briar sets your first work. Look this hearth. Find Flint in the South Orchard. Come back.
reminderNarration: Look the Hearth of Thorns. Visit the South Orchard. Attack the dummy. Then talk Briar.
completionNarration: Briar's shears click shut. Thorns have your name, if not yet your patience.

objectives.label: Look around the Hearth of Thorns.
